note: 175-card desktop manifest derived from the Android3 bundle (106 IR + 69 hand). All paths are package-relative POSIX; the data/ prefix is the bundle copied verbatim as the package data root. slots are node declarations: IR carries the e2b report nodePath (b<band>/g<child>…) for path binding, hand carries the frozen text-slot id plus sampleText (e4hand reports no path). No slot is removed for the sample photo; optionalSlotsAtSampleExif only records which nodes resolve empty for the bundle fixture. Kept alongside x1-cards.json (10 cards) for the caller to switch.

dataLayout.irAssetResolution: e2b resolves ir.assets[key].file by replacing the extension with .png under --decoded; the decoded cache mirrors that relative path (data/decoded/{vendor}/{asset}.png) and copies data/logos into data/decoded/logos for the EXIF brand wordmark lookup.
dataLayout.slotPolicy: slots are node declarations and are never cropped to the sample photo. IR: {slotId,nodePath,optional} where nodePath is e2b report items[].path (b<band>/g<child>…, document-order indices including Space nodes); the bridge binds each report draw by path. Hand: {slotId,nodePath:null,sampleText,…} from the frozen text-slots probe; e4hand reports no path, so the bridge aligns draws to slots by sampleText and marks drawn-but-undeclared lines unmapped.

slotBinding.ir: byPath: report items[] text .path → declared nodePath; unmapped draws keep their path as id with unmapped=true; declared slots without a draw get present=false.
slotBinding.hand: byText: frozen slotId + sampleText alignment, order independent; unmatched slot → present=false, unmatched draw → unmapped=true.
slotBinding.legacyStringArrays: x1-cards.json style ["model","params"] is still read for compatibility and bound by array index (old behaviour); cards-175.json always emits objects.

engineInvocation.note: IR cards need the engine-side decoded cache; hand cards resolve photo/logo/design from data/hand/cards.json relative to the data root.

fixture.note: optionalSlotsAtSampleExif only records which declared nodes resolve empty for this fixture (photo + EXIF, no --location/--custom); it is evidence, never a cropping rule.
